title: Foundations: Peace Songs - The Complete Guide
summary: What Peace Songs is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Peace Songs songs: Protest songs turn music into a picket sign: plain language, singable choruses, and moral clarity. From labor anthems to civil-rights freedom songs to anti-war ballads, they give movements a voice.

History: The labor movement's Little Red Songbook (1909), the civil-rights freedom songs (1960s), Dylan's early-60s broadsides, and Marvin Gaye's What's Going On (1971) each weaponized song.

How the songs work: Peace Songs favors the keys of G, C, D, A, Em. Common forms include Call-and-response for marches; Verse-chorus with a chantable hook. Players should master singability over virtuosity first, then the chant: one line everyone can shout. Picket-line guitar: capo 2, strum hard.

title: Down by the Riverside - Complete Public-Domain Song
summary: Full lyrics and playing guide for Down by the Riverside, a public-domain Peace Songs standard.
body:
Down by the Riverside (Traditional African-American spiritual, 19th century. Public domain.) is public domain, so this record carries the complete lyrics — sing it, teach it, record it freely.

COMPLETE LYRICS:
Gonna lay down my sword and shield
down by the riverside, down by the riverside, down by the riverside,
gonna lay down my sword and shield
down by the riverside, gonna study war no more.

Chorus:
I ain't gonna study war no more, ain't gonna study war no more,
ain't gonna study war no more.
I ain't gonna study war no more, ain't gonna study war no more,
ain't gonna study war no more.

Gonna put on my long white robe
down by the riverside, down by the riverside, down by the riverside,
gonna put on my long white robe
down by the riverside, gonna study war no more.

Gonna lay down my heavy load
down by the riverside, down by the riverside, down by the riverside,
gonna lay down my heavy load
down by the riverside, gonna study war no more.

G | C | D | G

Technique: singability over virtuosity. Picket-line guitar: capo 2, strum hard.
